item.description:
**Control how much space cached scans use**
- Settings → Cached Scans now shows current cache storage usage. - Set a maximum cache size from 64 to 16,384 MiB. The default remains 1,024 MiB (1 GiB). - Both scan-count and size limits apply. Lowering a limit removes cached metadata immediately; your scanned files and open results stay intact. - Scans larger than the chosen budget remain open but are not cached. Size limits persist across launches and apply to new scans.
Apple Silicon · macOS 14 or later. This free release is self-signed and unnotarized; first-launch approval remains under your control. Existing automatic updates use the signed feed.
